driver-gloves-snow-leopard.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard
driver-gloves-snow-leopard.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

driver-gloves-queen-jaguar.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Queen Jaguar
driver-gloves-queen-jaguar.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

sport-gloves-amphibious.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Amphibious
sport-gloves-amphibious.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. These synthetic blue and white gloves are quick drying and breathable.

bloodhound-gloves-guerrilla.name: ★ Bloodhound Gloves | Guerrilla
bloodhound-gloves-guerrilla.desc:
These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Bloodhound logo. It was made with a mix of brown leather and synthetic leather with a camo print.

Valeria plans on retribution, of that there can be no doubt... - Sebastien Hennequet, Sniper

ak-47-uncharted.name: AK-47 | Uncharted
ak-47-uncharted.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom paint job of various tribal patterns has been applied.

We share the same canoe

ak-47-baroque-purple.name: AK-47 | Baroque Purple
ak-47-baroque-purple.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. An intricate, Italian inspired hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Last Supper is served

aug-spalted-wood.name: AUG | Spalted Wood
aug-spalted-wood.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A hydrographic pattern resembling dried wood has been applied.

Knock on wood; you're gonna need all the luck you can get - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

awp-sovereign-flame.name: AWP | Sovereign Flame
awp-sovereign-flame.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a golden scope and flames running the length of the weapon.

The exalted won

pp-bizon-brass.name: PP-Bizon | Brass
pp-bizon-brass.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. Parts of the weapon have been replaced with brass.

Fool's gold

cz75-auto-chalice.name: CZ75-Auto | Chalice
cz75-auto-chalice.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent royal blue and amber anodized effect paint.

You chose wisely

cz75-auto-jungle-dashed.name: CZ75-Auto | Jungle Dashed
cz75-auto-jungle-dashed.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

desert-eagle-meteorite.name: Desert Eagle | Meteorite
desert-eagle-meteorite.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

dual-berettas-switch-board.name: Dual Berettas | Switch Board
dual-berettas-switch-board.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do

famas-meow-36.name: FAMAS | Meow 36
famas-meow-36.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. Its green base is emblazoned with the number 36.

Technically it's four cats, but who's counting?

five-seven-buddy.name: Five-SeveN | Buddy
five-seven-buddy.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with camo patterns and a CT beneath the rear sight.

I've got your six

five-seven-neon-kimono.name: Five-SeveN | Neon Kimono
five-seven-neon-kimono.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a geometric motif.

I know I'm asking a lot of you... Turner was like your son - The Paladin and The Teacher Part 1

five-seven-nitro.name: Five-SeveN | Nitro
five-seven-nitro.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

g3sg1-contractor.name: G3SG1 | Contractor
g3sg1-contractor.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has individual parts spray-painted tan, navy and dark green.

Rona Sabri still hasn't forgiven Sebastien for not selecting her to go after Turner

glock-18-oxide-blaze.name: Glock-18 | Oxide Blaze
glock-18-oxide-blaze.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A custom paint job has been applied with a rust-colored base and white detailing.

"The subject claims this washed up on shore"

glock-18-shinobu.name: Glock-18 | Shinobu
glock-18-shinobu.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a woman on the slide wearing SR Tech "Premium" contact lenses.

"SR Tech—helping you stay focused one engagement at a time"

p2000-amber-fade.name: P2000 | Amber Fade
p2000-amber-fade.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

butterfly-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

survival-knife-fade.name: ★ Survival Knife | Fade
survival-knife-fade.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

survival-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Survival Knife | Blue Steel
survival-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

paracord-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Crimson Web
paracord-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

classic-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Classic Knife | Crimson Web
classic-knife-crimson-web.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

falchion-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Safari Mesh
falchion-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

gut-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Gut Knife | Rust Coat
gut-knife-rust-coat.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

karambit-black-laminate.name: ★ Karambit | Black Laminate
karambit-black-laminate.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

kukri-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Safari Mesh
kukri-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

m9-bayonet-boreal-forest.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Boreal Forest
m9-bayonet-boreal-forest.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

skeleton-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Boreal Forest
skeleton-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

stiletto-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Safari Mesh
stiletto-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

bowie-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Tiger Tooth
bowie-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Marble Fade
huntsman-knife-marble-fade.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

ursus-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Rust Coat
ursus-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

talon-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Talon Knife | Urban Masked
talon-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

m249-spectre.name: M249 | Spectre
m249-spectre.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been painted in a sleek and contemporary manner.

The Phoenix civil war is about to begin

m249-shipping-forecast.name: M249 | Shipping Forecast
m249-shipping-forecast.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

Who knows what the future holds

m4a4-spider-lily.name: M4A4 | Spider Lily
m4a4-spider-lily.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a dark blue base and red spider lilies above the magazine and trigger.

Bright colors are a warning, not an invitation

m4a4-urban-ddpat.name: M4A4 | Urban DDPAT
m4a4-urban-ddpat.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m4a4-converter.name: M4A4 | Converter
m4a4-converter.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A red and black mesh hydrographic has been applied.

Not so harmful after all...

m4a4-dark-operative.name: M4A4 | Dark Operative
m4a4-dark-operative.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted in matte black and silver and finished with white graphic designs.

Function before style

m4a4-full-throttle.name: M4A4 | Full Throttle
m4a4-full-throttle.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a neon green base and finished with fictitious logos meant to evoke drift and tuning culture.

Where "Globoil 1 Synthetics" meets "ENTRI PERFORMANCE"

m4a1-s-printstream.name: M4A1-S | Printstream
m4a1-s-printstream.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1; SILENCED_1;

mac-10-surfwood.name: MAC-10 | Surfwood
mac-10-surfwood.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been spray-painted with a pale green and cream colored design.

Mint condition

mag-7-heaven-guard.name: MAG-7 | Heaven Guard
mag-7-heaven-guard.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted using a combination of subtly patterned hydrographics and dry-transfer decals of wings.

Sometimes the wings of an angel don't mean salvation

mag-7-praetorian.name: MAG-7 | Praetorian
mag-7-praetorian.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been distinguishly painted with metallics.

The spire is forming

mp7-full-stop.name: MP7 | Full Stop
mp7-full-stop.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

mp7-short-ochre.name: MP7 | Short Ochre
mp7-short-ochre.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using different shades of yellow.

Here's some new material...

mp7-prey.name: MP7 | Prey
mp7-prey.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted with a rust colored zebra stripe pattern.

Eat, sleep, hunt, repeat

mp9-dark-age.name: MP9 | Dark Age
mp9-dark-age.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted with metallic paints to look as though it has been inlaid with metals in a medieval motif.

I could kill her paramour... perhaps that would buy you some time with Valeria - A Father's Love Part 2

mp9-dizzy.name: MP9 | Dizzy
mp9-dizzy.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A grayscale DDPAT has been applied.

Round and round we go

negev-loudmouth.name: Negev | Loudmouth
negev-loudmouth.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with a monstrous design and then distressed.

Get back here, I'm talking to you!

nova-ghost-camo.name: Nova | Ghost Camo
nova-ghost-camo.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted using a hydrographic with an oversized camouflage pattern.

p250-drought.name: P250 | Drought
p250-drought.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted with a pattern of animal skulls.

All that remains

p90-desert-ddpat.name: P90 | Desert DDPAT
p90-desert-ddpat.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

p90-death-grip.name: P90 | Death Grip
p90-death-grip.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A hydrographic pattern of overlapping hands has been applied to a blue base.

Do not go quietly

p90-blue-tac.name: P90 | Blue Tac
p90-blue-tac.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A blue and grey hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Let it rip

p90-glacier-mesh.name: P90 | Glacier Mesh
p90-glacier-mesh.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

scar-20-caged.name: SCAR-20 | Caged
scar-20-caged.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A blue and purple gradient design has been applied.

"That's a big weapon for such a small cage..."

ssg-08-memorial.name: SSG 08 | Memorial
ssg-08-memorial.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. This custom paint job depicts bronze engravings and is inspired by the concrete efficiency of brutalist architecture.

May your sacrifice not be in vain

tec-9-cracked-opal.name: Tec-9 | Cracked Opal
tec-9-cracked-opal.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been hand painted to resemble cracked, ancient wood with an underlying opal.

Doubles as a mood ring

tec-9-banana-leaf.name: Tec-9 | Banana Leaf
tec-9-banana-leaf.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A yellow and black banana leaf pattern has been applied.

Rich in potassium

tec-9-citric-acid.name: Tec-9 | Citric Acid
tec-9-citric-acid.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A dark paint splat pattern is applied over a yellow and green base.

Warm regards

ump-45-oscillator.name: UMP-45 | Oscillator
ump-45-oscillator.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A randomized pattern in orange, black, and grey has been applied.

Everyone has a breaking point; where's yours?

ump-45-riot.name: UMP-45 | Riot
ump-45-riot.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted using a combination of hydrographics and heat-transfer decals.

If you didn't want collateral damage, perhaps you should have been more specific... - Javier Alviso, Fist of the Phoenix

xm1014-charter.name: XM1014 | Charter
xm1014-charter.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A tan-colored pattern of crests, scrawls, and text from the Magna Carta has been applied.

Everyone is subject to due process—even you
